content:
Isha Rao: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem on the vendor cascade (cloud provider regional flake -> model-registry auth thrash). Thread to lock owners + dates.
Caleb Winters: I'll take auth fallback. Plan: edge-proxy cached token (60s), feature-flagged. PR with tests by Tue EOD.
Mina Park: I'll own token rotation runbook. Rotate at 75% TTL, include KMS steps and rollback. Dry-run in staging on Thu. Draft runbook by Wed.
Diego Santos: I'll handle provider routing and vendor escalation updates. Will add escalation contacts to SLA appendix and request account team update. Target: EOW.
OpsBot: Incident IR-2026-058: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-058. Peak impact ~1.0% traffic, duration ~36m. Runbook seed: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/vendor-cascade-seed.
Isha Rao: Monitoring owner? Need alert for auth_fail spikes and weekly synthetic.
Caleb Winters: I'll add an alert: model_registry.auth_fail_rate > 0.6% for 5m -> page SRE + trigger canary. Also add a weekly Tue 03:00 UTC synthetic hitting registry at 2x QPS. PR queued.
Mina Park: Acceptance criteria: fallback merged behind flag + canary verified; runbook dry-run completed in staging; vendor contacts updated; synthetic scheduled. I'll track in the remediation sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-vendor-followups-2026.
Diego Santos: Noting recurring-pattern tag for quarterly review. Once items are DONE we'll schedule a 90-min cross-team drill.
Isha Rao: Timeline recap: Caleb PR Tue EOD; Mina runbook Wed + dry-run Thu; Diego SLA updates EOW; Caleb monitoring by next Tue. Weekly 10-min sync starting next Mon. Post PR/runbook links here and mark DONE in the sheet. :white_check_mark:
